description: Defines the EncryptedSettingsPayload class for building and parsing WSC encrypted configuration data, including methods for serialization, deserialization, and attribute access.

classes.name: EncryptedSettingsPayload
classes.description: A class for building and parsing WSC encrypted configuration data, handling attribute serialization and deserialization.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the payload with given configuration data.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the payload data is valid.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new EncryptedSettingsPayload instance from configuration data.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an existing buffer into an EncryptedSettingsPayload instance.

methods.name: ssid
methods.description: Returns the SSID attribute as a string.

methods.name: bss_type
methods.description: Returns the BSS type attribute based on vendor extension data.

methods.name: key_wrap_authenticator
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the key wrap authenticator data.

methods.name: key_wrap_authenticator_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the key wrap authenticator data.
